technical.summary: CTSH shows strong bullish structure with price above all key MAs and positive momentum indicators, but overbought RSI conditions and weak ADX trend strength limit entry probability for swing trades.

fundamental.summary: CTSH shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, absent government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 36 days present timing risk.

sentiment.summary: No congressional signal with stale trades (250+ days old); Fear index (41) presents mild contrarian opportunity but insufficient conviction from any source to establish directional bias.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (397.6), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising USD pressuring multinational earnings, with earnings event in 36 days adding execution risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with three white soldiers pattern and RSI momentum suggests near-term upside to 86.268 resistance in a technical vacuum.
debate.key_bear_argument: VIX crisis (397.6), macro headwinds (rising USD, flat yield curve), overbought RSI (70.61) with weak ADX (12.59), earnings in 36 days, and zero fundamental/smart money conviction create asymmetric downside risk that outweighs technical setup.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical setup shows price above all major MAs with three white soldiers pattern, but this is insufficient to overcome macro headwinds and fundamental weakness in a VIX crisis environment.
decision.primary_risk: VIX in crisis territory (397.6) combined with flat yield curve recession signal and rising USD headwinds create severe macro downside risk that technical overbought conditions (RSI 70.61, weak ADX 12.59) cannot sustain through earnings in 36 days.
